title: content/chapters/*.json
description: 14 §6 — a chapter definition, transcribed field-for-field from the worked example in that section. CONTENT schema, not a tuning schema: the chapter files themselves belong to M2/M3. powerTarget must agree with the matching cell in tuning/par_power.json.

id.description: 14 §6 — the chapter number. Unique across content/chapters/.

powerTarget.description: 29 §4.1 — must equal parPower[id].NORMAL in tuning/par_power.json. A mismatch means the content and the par table have drifted apart.

stageLengths.description: 02 §1 — 3 stages. The boss tile is additional to these.

eliteCount.description: One entry per stage, matching stageLengths.

tileWeights.description: 03 — one weight map per stage. Every key must be a tile id that exists.

enemyPool.description: Weighted enemy archetypes. Every key must resolve to an enemy definition in content/enemies/ — an unresolvable key is an orphaned reference and fails the build (14 §6).

elitePool.description: 05 §6.2 — the chapter's two biome elites. game-data/README.md 🔒: content/elites/ is empty and stays empty, because an elite modifier has no identity apart from the enemy it is drawn onto; every id here resolves against content/enemies/enemies.json#/elites/identities instead, which is the single source of truth for the EL_ id space (R32 cross-checks it there). Erratum fixed here: this field used to describe a content/elites/ directory that the README rules out.

bossId.description: 17 — must resolve to a boss definition in content/bosses/.

unlockCondition.description: 10 §7 — Chapter c Normal is unlocked by clearing Chapter c-1 Normal. Chapter 1 has no prerequisite and carries null.
